Ayesha Sinha
Senior Digital Marketing Manager | Ahmedabad
ayesha.sinha614@example.com | +91 9509840896

Result-driven digital marketing leader with a track record of improving acquisition efficiency and engagement across paid and organic channels. Combines analytical rigor with creative campaign management to scale lead generation and retention for education and healthcare brands. Comfortable leading cross-functional teams in Agile environments; available with a 30 days notice period.

- Collaborated with product and analytics teams in Agile sprints using Jira to accelerate landing page iterations, improving conversion rate by 14% on high-intent campaigns.

Medisure, May 2019 - Mar 2025
Digital Marketing Manager

- Built Email Marketing lifecycle campaigns targeting retention and re-engagement, raising patient rebook rate by 21% and improving revenue per email by 33%.
- Led Social Media Marketing for brand and acquisition, driving a 3x increase in referral traffic from social channels and coordinating cross-functional Agile planning in Jira.

Projects
